lastResponse.text: I hear you, and we’ll keep this simple. If you feel unsafe or might lose control, call nine one one now. For immediate mental health help today, call eight eight eight, six eight eight, five four two eight. I’ll repeat: eight eight eight, six eight eight, five four two eight. If we disconnect, call that number first and say you need same-day help in Gresham and want a warm handoff.
originalTexts: I hear you, and we’ll keep this simple. If you feel unsafe or might lose control, call 911 now. For immediate mental health help today, call (888) 688-5428. I’ll repeat: (888) 688-5428. If we disconnect, call that number first and say you need same-day help in Gresham and want a warm handoff.
